_comment: The same single-file shape as guessed-seam.json, except the findings name what the import exports. That naming is the evidence the ranking otherwise lacks, so the seam is substantiated and the class is gated normally.

findings.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep the decision atomic with what is pushed**

The verdict is taken before the lock is held, so a concurrent writer can change what the call sends after it was judged.

The call into `evaluateGate` is where this has to hold. Nothing revalidates it, so the race stands.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Revalidate the ref along with the revision**

The revision is compared but the ref is not, so a concurrent writer pointing another ref at the same revision passes `evaluateGate` unchanged. Nothing revalidates it, so the race stands.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Judge the identity that was captured**

The reads still follow ambient state rather than the identity captured up front, so the verdict can describe something the call will not send.

The call into `evaluateGate` is where this has to hold. A concurrent writer wins the race unless this is revalidated.
